topic.title: Turtle Keyboard Events
topic.description: Demonstrates setting up keyboard event listeners with screen.listen() and screen.onkey(). A foundation for building interactive turtle applications.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using screen.listen() to activate key listening and screen.onkey() to bind a function to a specific key press.
learningNotes.challenges: Understanding that functions must be passed without parentheses as callbacks.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Bind multiple keys for full directional control.

files.description: Turtle moves forward when space key is pressed.
